text:
Tara (oncall): Quick handoff — a few tidy notes before I drop off for the evening. No active incidents but a couple of things to watch and small action items.

Tara (oncall): What changed: patched a prefetch memory leak in the embed pipeline (deployed at 22:10 UTC). Cache TTL bumped from 10m -> 20m for the small-embed cache to reduce churn.

Tara (oncall): What to watch: 1) KV eviction spikes around heavy batch jobs — saw ~320 evictions last night at ~02:05 UTC (baseline ~15) after the nightly indexing job. If evictions > 200 for > 5m, please escalate. 2) EU dedicated canary scheduled tonight at 03:15 UTC — small rolling restart of 3 nodes (no full outage expected).

Alex K: ack. I can own the EU canary. I'll keep an eye on p95 latency and token cost. Will pause if error-rate > 0.5% during rollout.

Maria S: FYI PR #4238 (rate-limit fixes for internal batch) merged and is in prod. I added a short-lived internal quota to mitigate the batch bursts. If you see traffic drop on /v1/embeddings, that's intentional.

Jin L: note — the indexing cron job got a config tweak (reduces concurrency but increases IO per-worker). Expect short 1–3s latency blips on fetch-heavy routes between 02:00–02:30 UTC. Nothing to roll back, just FYI.

Noah P: added a guard: `kubectl patch hpa prefetch --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":2}}'` in the eu-dedicated namespace. That should help keep coldstart blips down during the restart window.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: eu-dedicated/canary -> rolling restart of statefulset prefetcher @ 03:15 UTC. Owner: Alex K.

Tara (oncall): Action items before handoff: 1) Alex — run the quick smoke after canary (script: `scripts/smoke/eu_canary.sh`) and paste results here. 2) Maria — keep the temporary quota active until tomorrow morning and confirm removal plan. 3) Jin — drop a short note in the index-ops doc about the IO profile change.

Tara (oncall): Contacts while I'm off: Alex K (primary), Noah P (secondary). If something spikes, start with metric snapshot (p95, evictions, 5xx rate) and ping #eng-oncall-bridge.

Alex K: Got it. I'll post smoke results after the rollout and tag @Tara and @Noah.

Maria S: Will keep the quota til 09:00 UTC tomorrow and then open a quick PR to remove.

Jin L: I'll update the index-ops doc and include test results for the new config.

Tara (oncall): One last FYI — no pager rule changes, just the temporary quota and config tweak. All low risk but worth watching during the 02:00–03:30 UTC window. Thanks team, leaving handoff to Alex. :wave:

Alex K: Thanks — taking 👀 now. If anything weird show up I'll escalate.

Noah P: standing by, ping me if the evictions climb again.

Tara (oncall): Signing off — enjoy the evening.
